comment:
* Implementation of {@link CodedInputStream} that uses an {@link Iterable <ByteBuffer>} as the
   * data source. Requires the use of {@code sun.misc.Unsafe} to perform fast reads on the buffer.

variables.name: input
variables.comment: The object that need to decode.

variables.name: iterator
variables.comment: The {@link Iterator} with type {@link ByteBuffer} of {@code input}

variables.name: immutable
variables.comment:
* If {@code true}, indicates that all the buffers are backing a {@link ByteString} and are
     * therefore considered to be an immutable input source.

variables.name: enableAliasing
variables.comment: * If {@code true}, indicates that calls to read {@link ByteString} or {@code byte[]} * may return slices of the underlying buffer, rather than copies.

variables.name: totalBufferSize
variables.comment: The global total message length limit

variables.name: bufferSizeAfterCurrentLimit
variables.comment: The amount of available data in the input beyond {@link #currentLimit}.

variables.name: currentLimit
variables.comment: The absolute position of the end of the current message.

variables.name: lastTag
variables.comment: The last tag that was read from this stream.

variables.name: totalBytesRead
variables.comment: Total Bytes have been Read from the {@link Iterable} {@link ByteBuffer}

variables.name: startOffset
variables.comment: The start position offset of the whole message, used as to reset the totalBytesRead

variables.name: currentByteBufferPos
variables.comment: The current position for current ByteBuffer

variables.name: currentAddress
variables.comment:
* If the current ByteBuffer is unsafe-direct based, currentAddress is the start address of this
     * ByteBuffer; otherwise should be zero.

variables.name: currentByteBufferLimit
variables.comment: The limit position for current ByteBuffer
